name: ANSI/IEEE led indicator lamp symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for led indicator lamp, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The LED indicator form identifies a documented panel indication assembly using a light-emitting semiconductor. Its rated input and any polarity requirement belong to the complete assembly rather than to an assumed bare LED.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Read the assembly terminal and supply data.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A panel LED indicator may contain internal limiting or protection components absent from a bare LED symbol.
